name: Lefdal Mine Datacenter
notes: Located near Nordfjordeid/Maloy in Vestland. Invest in Vestland reports 37 MW operational customer capacity plus 43 MW under construction; Lefdal states long-term expansion potential up to 200 MW.

name: Tydal Data Center AI conversion
developer: Bitdeer Technologies Group / Tydal Data Center AS; Data Center Installations AS contractor
notes: Existing Tydal/Kirkvollen facility in Trondelag being converted from bitcoin mining to an AI colocation data center. Reported gross installed capacity is 180 MW with expected completion in December 2026.

name: Green Edge Compute Sluppen Trondheim data center
developer: Green Edge Compute AS with Statkraft / Trondheim Municipality
notes: Urban edge data center at Sluppen in Trondheim. Initial agreement described a 1-5 MW facility connected to district heating; +CityxChange reported the facility operational in June 2022.

name: NorthDC Arctic colocation data center
notes: NorthDC says it is planning construction and operation of a colocation data center in Northern Norway's Arctic region, Troms fylke. No public MW figure found.
